parameters.value: A medical device used to treat neonatal hyperbilirubinemia (jaundice) by exposing the infant to a specific wavelength of blue light, which converts bilirubin into a form that can be excreted.
Overhead Unit (mounted on a mobile stand)
Minimum 40 cm x 20 cm or better
Mobile Stand on Casters wheels (4), Fixed/Attached to Warmer/Cradle
Tiltable Head (0-90 degrees) with height adjustment

parameters.parameter: Compliance to Drugs and Cosmetic Act 1940 and Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017 as amended till date
Availability of valid Medical Device license for the product issued from the competent authority
